title: Delphic manumission acts (sale-to-Apollo); RU «Дельфийские акты об отпуске рабов»; pilot: earliest c. 100 acts
author: Anonymous (Delphic sanctuary/civic records)
edition: SGDI II (Baunack 1892–99; public domain, archive.org sammlungdergriec0201colluoft/0202); FD III; standard: Mulliez, CID V (EFA 2020, 2023; copyrighted)
ru_evidence: CyberLeninka searches ('манумиссия Дельфы', 'дельфийские надписи об отпуске рабов') found studies only. The ancientrome.ru Delphi section has only Zelinsky's literary oracles.
en_evidence: No English corpus translation found. BMCR 2024.02.43 on Mulliez mentions no English. Only isolated sourcebook examples (from memory).
other_translations: French, selective: Mulliez, CID V vol. 1 (2020), 'not in every case', list on p. 655 (BMCR 2024.02.43)
value: The largest Greek dossier on slavery and manumission: slaves' names, origins, prices, paramonē (continued-service) obligations, women, families, guarantors. Central for social, legal and economic history, prosopography and onomastics; used by historians of slavery and of Delphi.
ai_feasibility: high: very formulaic, clear structure. Risks: dating by archons and priesthoods, legal terms (paramonē, bebaiōtēr), lacunae.
pilot_unit: Acts of the first priesthoods (c. 201–170 BC): c. 100 acts from SGDI (public domain), c. 10–12k words
